function.name: view_image
function.description: View a PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP image (max 8 MiB); sends it to the model.

function.name: read
function.description: Batch read UTF-8 line ranges (1-based, inclusive). Default 200, maximum 1000 lines per range. Returns bounded JSON with per-file errors and continuation; prefer search first.

function.name: write
function.description: Create or overwrite a file. Requires approval.

function.name: edit
function.description: Apply 1..64 sequential replacements atomically to one file. Each old must match exactly once; line_number disambiguates a single-line occurrence. All replacements validate before writing. Requires approval.

function.name: list
function.description: List one workspace directory with bounded JSON and numeric continuation. Use glob for recursive discovery.

function.name: glob
function.description: Find workspace-relative file paths recursively using glob patterns. Skips .git, node_modules, target and .i by default; path narrows traversal. Returns bounded JSON and numeric continuation.

function.name: search
function.description: Search UTF-8 file lines, literal and case-sensitive by default. Optional line-based Rust regex (no lookaround/backreferences), glob filter, 0..3 context lines or filenames-only mode. Returns bounded JSON with opaque continuation and skipped file count. Narrow path/glob to reduce scanning.

function.name: download
function.description: Prepare workspace files as a ZIP. Defaults to the whole workspace. Browser shows a save link; native saves under .i/downloads/.

function.name: shell
function.description: Run a shell command with timeout. Requires approval. NOT sandboxed.
